basis: Congenital herpesvirus infection; lasting neurologic, ocular and hearing damage varies by virus and symptomatic subgroup, without a shared >=30% estimate.
Localized thymic epithelial tumor; thymus itself falls outside the specified axes. Associated autoimmune disease or immunodeficiency is separately diagnosed.
Carcinoma arising in the lip or oral cavity; oral mucosa belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Cervical spinal degeneration with skeletal abnormalities; accompanying myelopathy or radiculopathy is not established.
Immune-mediated Guillain-Barre subtype directly injuring motor and sensory peripheral axons.
Benign perineurial nerve-sheath tumor characteristically arising in dermis or subcutis, especially of the hands.
Isolated congenital fusion or webbing of digits is a structural limb malformation; syndromic organ abnormalities are excluded.
Periosteal bone proliferation and joint involvement define the disease; underlying lung or heart conditions are separate diseases.
Idiopathic ischemic necrosis of bone; impaired blood supply does not itself establish a cardiovascular disease.
TRAPPC9-related intellectual disability with microcephaly and brain abnormalities; obesity alone does not establish direct endocrine injury.
Adenocarcinoma originates in anal canal mucosa, anal glands or fistulous tract epithelium.
Hereditary structural malformation of the brain; no other organ involvement is established.
Congenital peripheral hypomyelination; structural amyotrophy, scoliosis and flat feet each reported in 1/1 assessed patient support musculoskeletal involvement, with limited sampling.
B-cell lymphoma with common marrow and splenic infiltration, covered by haematologic; gastrointestinal abnormalities are annotated at only 5-29%.
Proliferative lesion confined to breast ducts; breast has no axis.
Viral infection with thrombocytopenia/coagulopathy; endothelial injury with capillary leak in 80-99% and hepatitis in most support vascular and hepatic involvement.
Benign hepatocyte neoplasm; the endocrine ancestor does not describe its actual tissue of origin.
Benign ovarian epithelial cystic tumor without a defined hormonal disorder; reproductive organs have no axis.
Isolated NANOS1-related failure of sperm production; reproductive dysfunction without endocrine disease.
Hereditary peripheral sensorimotor neuropathy with defining structural skin hyperelasticity.
Hypomyelination and cataracts define the syndrome; muscle atrophy in 9/10 and scoliosis in 4/10 support musculoskeletal involvement. Delayed auditory conduction is neurologic.
Squamous carcinoma arising in buccal oral mucosa.
Anterior pituitary neoplasm; visual damage is concentrated in larger tumors and is not established in >=30% across the full adenoma umbrella.
Cerebellar developmental disorder; strabismus 6/9, scoliosis 6/10 and severe periodontitis 2/2 support ocular, skeletal and oral involvement; cohorts are small.
Acute myeloid leukemia defined by a chromosome 13 deletion; malignant myeloid cells involve blood and marrow.
